task.summary: Refactor `.idea` configs, update navigation for project routing, and enhance contact section styling and behavior.

Integrate Snipcart for e-commerce functionality:
- Added Snipcart support via API key in `_config.yml` and `_includes/snipcart.html`. - Enabled cart button in `navbar` and product pages when Snipcart is active. - Updated project layout templates to integrate "Add to Cart" buttons and dynamic Snipcart data attributes. - Enhanced styling for cart buttons and counters in `style.scss`. - Added new i18n translation keys for cart-related features (English/Polish).

Add debugging configuration and update i18n keys and content
- Added `.claude/launch.json` and `.claude/settings.json` for Jekyll debugging setup. - Updated i18n keys and content to refine branding and introduce cart-related translations (English/Polish). - Adjusted `.scss` for improved layout and responsiveness. - Simplified layouts by removing unused tags and redundant buttons.

Add "Leather Tray" project with multilingual support
- Created project pages for "Leather Tray"/"Taca Skórzana" in English and Polish, including hero and gallery SVGs. - Added detailed product descriptions, features, pricing, and warranty information. - Updated i18n keys and metadata to support multilingual navigation and project consistency. - Enhanced styling for project layout and gallery images. - Included the Elense logo SVG and adjusted favicon logic.

Update "About" and "Contact" sections with refined content and styling
- Introduced a new subtitle in the "About" section for improved navigation. - Refined and expanded "Contact" section text to enhance clarity and user engagement. - Updated i18n keys for additional multilingual support. - Added responsive styling for the "Contact" section's introduction text.

Adjust Snipcart modal and overlay styling for navbar offset
- Introduced `--elense-navbar-offset` CSS variable for consistent spacing. - Updated Snipcart modal, overlay, and

Rename "Projects" to "Products" across all content
- Updated URLs, navigation, and metadata to reflect the change. - Adjusted i18n keys, breadcrumbs, and YAML configurations. - Updated links in blog posts, project pages, and product descriptions for consistency.

Refine Snipcart styling with new color variables and modal adjustments
- Introduced custom CSS variables for Snipcart components to align with brand aesthetics. - Updated modal, input, button, and badge styling for improved consistency and responsiveness. - Included minor adjustments to `.idea` configuration.

Integrate Etsy shop links and update branding elements
- Added Etsy URLs to product pages, "Contact," and "About" sections. - Updated favicon assets with new designs and sizes. - Refined CSS for Etsy button styling and product layout adjustments. - Updated branding elements, including new logos and email addresses.
